title: Lab - Kustomize patches
scenario: Patch a Deployment three ways. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Replicas
tasks.instructions: Patch the api Deployment to 5 replicas with a JSON 6902 patch.
tasks.solution: # patches: [{target: {kind: Deployment, name: api}, patch: "- op: replace\n  path: /spec/replicas\n  value: 5"}]

tasks.title: Task 2 - Label
tasks.instructions: Add label env=production to the Pod template with a strategic merge patch.
tasks.solution: # a patch file with just metadata.name and the template labels

tasks.title: Task 3 - Remove
tasks.instructions: Remove the second container from the Deployment by index.
